mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment_reports (comment_id, user_id, reason, reason_detail) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{userId}, #{reason}, #{reasonDetail})
mapper.select: SELECT reason AS reason, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comment_reports WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} GROUP BY reason ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT reason_detail FROM comment_reports WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND reason = 'other' AND reason_detail IS NOT NULL AND reason_detail <> '' ORDER BY created_at
